title: Arithmetic operations using switch case (use prompt)

files.name: arithmetic.html
files.code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<body>
    <script>
        let a = Number(prompt("Enter first number"));
        let b = Number(prompt("Enter second number"));
        let op = prompt("Enter operator + - * / %");
        switch (op) {
            case "+": 
                document.write("Sum = " + (a + b)); 
                break;
            case "-": 
                document.write("Difference = " + (a - b)); 
                break;
            case "*": 
                document.write("Product = " + (a * b)); 
                break;
            case "/": 
                document.write("Quotient = " + (a / b)); 
                break;
            case "%": 
                document.write("Remainder = " + (a % b)); 
                break;
            default: 
                document.write("Invalid operator");
        }
    </script>
</body>
</html>

title: Convert temperature from Celsius to Fahrenheit using functions

files.name: temperature.html
files.code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<body>
    <script>
        function toF(c) {
            return c * 9 / 5 + 32;
        }
        let c = Number(prompt("Enter temperature in Celsius"));
        document.write(c + " °C = " + toF(c) + " °F");
    </script>
</body>
</html>

title: Design a number guess game

files.name: guess.html
files.code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<body>
    <script>
        let num = Math.floor(Math.random() * 10) + 1;
        let guess, count = 0;
        do {
            guess = Number(prompt("Guess a number between 1 and 10"));
            count++;
            if (guess > num) alert("Too high");
            else if (guess < num) alert("Too low");
        } while (guess != num);
        document.write("Correct! The number was " + num + ". Tries: " + count);
    </script>
</body>
</html>

files.name: bookstore.dtd
files.code:
<!ELEMENT bookstore (book+)>
<!ELEMENT book (title, author, price)>
<!ELEMENT title (#PCDATA)>
<!ELEMENT author (#PCDATA)>
<!ELEMENT price (#PCDATA)>

instruction: Note: + one or more, * zero or more, #PCDATA text, #REQUIRED attribute must be given. Open the .xml in a browser to see the tree. To check it against the DTD, use an online XML validator (e.g. xmlvalidation.com) or VS Code with the XML extension.
